label: the intercom
title: Intercom / doorbell

router.description: Intercom, doorbell or door buzzer: the bell doesn't ring, can't hear or talk to visitors, the buzzer doesn't open the entrance door, packages can't be delivered because of it.

neutral_message: An electrician needs to look at it.
neutral_message_de: Das sollte sich ein Elektriker ansehen.
follow_up_question: just checking in: does the bell ring again?
resolved_message: Good to hear. Message me any time if it stops again.
resolved_message_de: Schön. Melde dich jederzeit, wenn es wieder ausfällt.
extraction_hints: 'the doorbell doesn't ring' / 'I don't hear the bell' → ic_what=no_ring; 'it rings but I can't hear them' / 'they can't hear me' → ic_what=no_audio; 'the buzzer doesn't open the door' → ic_what=no_buzzer; 'my neighbour has the same problem' / 'nobody's bell works' → ic_neighbours=yes; 'the neighbours' bells work' → ic_neighbours=no.

questions.text: What isn't working: the bell doesn't ring, you can't hear or talk to the visitor, or the buzzer doesn't open the door?
questions.text_de: Was geht nicht: Es klingelt nicht, du kannst den Besuch nicht hören oder sprechen, oder der Türöffner macht nicht auf?

answers.no_audio: rings, but no sound or talking
answers.no_buzzer: the buzzer doesn't open the door

questions.reask: And what isn't working: ringing, talking, or the buzzer?
questions.reask_de: Und was geht nicht: Klingeln, Sprechen oder der Öffner?

questions.text: Do your neighbours have the same problem?
questions.text_de: Haben deine Nachbarn das gleiche Problem?
questions.reask: And do the neighbours have the same problem?
questions.reask_de: Und haben die Nachbarn das gleiche Problem?

questions.text: Many handsets have a small volume or mute switch on the side or bottom. Is it turned off or down?
questions.text_de: Viele Hörer haben seitlich oder unten einen kleinen Lautstärke- oder Stummschalter. Ist der aus oder ganz leise?

answers.was_off: it was off or down and is on now
answers.on: it's on, or there's no such switch

questions.reask: Could you check the small volume or mute switch on the handset?
questions.reask_de: Kannst du den kleinen Lautstärke- oder Stummschalter am Hörer prüfen?

causes.label: Handset muted or volume turned down
causes.tenant_message: Then it was just muted. Leave it on and tell me if the bell still doesn't ring next time someone comes.
causes.tenant_message_de: Dann war es nur stumm geschaltet. Lass es an und sag mir, falls es beim nächsten Besuch trotzdem nicht klingelt.

causes.label: Building intercom system fault (neighbours affected too)
causes.tenant_message: If the neighbours have it too, the building's intercom system is faulty, so an electrician needs to repair the central unit. Until then, visitors and deliveries can call you directly.
causes.tenant_message_de: Wenn die Nachbarn es auch haben, ist die Sprechanlage des Hauses defekt; ein Elektriker muss die Zentrale reparieren. Bis dahin können Besuch und Lieferdienste dich direkt anrufen.

causes.label: Faulty handset or wiring in the flat
causes.tenant_message: If it's only your flat, the handset or its wiring is faulty, so an electrician needs to replace or repair it.
causes.tenant_message_de: Wenn es nur deine Wohnung betrifft, ist der Hörer oder seine Leitung defekt; ein Elektriker muss ihn reparieren oder tauschen.

causes.label: Door buzzer / electric opener doesn't release the entrance door
causes.tenant_message: Then the electric door opener isn't releasing. Our caretaker Peter Wolf will check it and call an electrician if it's the opener itself.
causes.tenant_message_de: Dann löst der elektrische Türöffner nicht aus. Unser Hausmeister Peter Wolf prüft das und holt einen Elektriker, falls der Öffner selbst kaputt ist.

strategy: Ask ic_what unless known, then ic_neighbours (building-wide → electrician for the central unit).
Only your flat and the bell is silent: check the handset's mute/volume switch first (self-help).
The buzzer doesn't open the door: caretaker first.
At most 3 diagnostic questions, one per message. Never state a fact the tenant didn't give.
